messages.content:
Three independent readers read the same non-disclosure agreement (NDA) and decided whether it supports one statement (the hypothesis). They may agree or disagree, and a program has checked each of their quotes against the document. Your job is to make the final decision yourself, from the document.

<document>
<document 138 omitted, sha256 717bbb1d66a9079c>
</document>

<hypothesis>
Receiving Party may acquire information similar to Confidential Information from a third party.
</hypothesis>

<readings>
<reading id="A">
label: Entailment
confidence: 70
reason: Clause 2 excludes from the confidentiality obligations information the Receiving Party receives from a third party, which implies it may lawfully acquire similar information from third parties, though the document does not state this directly.
<quote check="exact">or (iii) was rightfully disclosed to it by a third party</quote>
</reading>
<reading id="B">
label: Entailment
confidence: 80
reason: The exclusions carve out information rightfully disclosed to the Receiving Party by a third party, so it may acquire such information from a third party without breaching the confidentiality obligations.
<quote check="exact">or (iii) was rightfully disclosed to it by a third party</quote>
</reading>
<reading id="C">
label: Entailment
confidence: 80
reason: The exclusions carve out information rightfully disclosed by a third party, implying the Receiving Party may acquire such information from third parties.
<quote check="exact">(iii) was rightfully disclosed to it by a third party</quote>
</reading>
</readings>

The readings are evidence about where to look, not votes: a majority can be wrong, and a quote marked "missing" was not found in the document. Read the relevant parts of the document yourself.

Choose exactly one label:
- Entailment: the document states or clearly implies that the hypothesis is true.
- Contradiction: the document states or clearly implies that the hypothesis is false.
- NotMentioned: the document does not address the hypothesis, or says too little to decide.

Evidence is required. For Entailment or Contradiction, give 1 to 3 quotes copied character for character from the document (no paraphrase, no ellipses), each as short as it can be while still carrying the point. They will be checked against the document. For NotMentioned, give an empty list.

Give a confidence from 0 to 100: your probability, in percent, that your label is correct. Give a one-sentence reason.

Answer only with the JSON object the response format asks for: label, confidence, quotes, reason.

content.text: {"label":"Entailment","confidence":82,"quotes":["(iii) was rightfully disclosed to it by a third party"],"reason":"Clause 2 excludes from the obligations information rightfully disclosed to the Receiving Party by a third party, which clearly implies it may acquire such similar information from third parties."}
